title: Object Storage: cool minimum days
content:
Object Storage cool minimum days is defined as follows: Minimum retention for cool-class objects; calendar days integer.

| Contract tier | Cool minimum days |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | cool minimum days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | cool minimum days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | cool minimum days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | cool minimum days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | cool minimum days: 30 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | cool minimum days: 30 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the cool minimum days entry is 30.
